audience: sales and account teams that manage customers, tasks and sales chances in Cirqll CRM

useCases.title: Find customers without a planned follow-up
useCases.text: List the customers and the tasks planned for them. Ask the assistant which customers have no task in the next 14 days.

useCases.title: Review open sales chances and their values
useCases.text: List the sales chances in the pipeline, filtered by stage or value. Open the customer behind a chance to read its details.

useCases.title: Prepare for the day's appointments
useCases.text: List the appointments in a date range for you or a colleague. Read the open tasks of those customers before each visit.

useCases.title: Find the right contact before a call
useCases.text: Find a customer, then list the contacts at that customer. Read the notes on the customer before you call.

useCases.title: Add a new customer with a follow-up task
useCases.text: Create a customer record with the fields you pass. Then create a task with a due date for the follow-up call.

useCases.title: Log a call or quote as a customer note
useCases.text: Attach a dated note to a customer after a call or a quote. The assistant can write the note from your summary.
